summary: Confirmed 30-amp + water (no sewer at nightly sites), operator online booking; added fees $50-55 from the operator's live rates page (undated, read 2026-10-20), 133 sites with only 19 RV sites sold by the night (pull-throughs, to 45 ft), showers/flush toilets/two dump stations/camp store, engine booking rules (1-night min, 7 nights online). Season left alone: the website states no campground dates (it mentions winter snowmobiling from the campsite and a year-round bathhouse); the booking engine is configured 03-16 to 12-16 but that is a setting, not a statement. Base $50 is at, not over, the price gate; 19 of 122 RV sites (~16%) sold nightly passes the 1-in-10 test.
